description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.01 each), causes [DEF, RES and MND -50% (8s)], causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)] if 0-3/4+ FF7 allies are alive, grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies, grants [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Barret], [Catastrophe Ability Tracker] and [Catastrophe Level] to the user

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 20% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 20% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 20% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 20% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 20% (15s)], [Imperil Water 20% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 20% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 20% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 20% (15s)]

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Barret
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Catastrophe (0~2), removed after using Catastrophe two times

description.name: Catastrophe Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Catastrophe level by 1 after using 7 Machinist or Support abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Barret]

description.name: Catastrophe Level
description.text: Keeps track of Catastrophe level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Barret]
